assertion_results.text: Bug parsing extracts the Environment / Version section content including the vague text (Step 1)
assertion_results.evidence: In bug-parsing.md lines 53-59, the 'Environment / Version' section is explicitly extracted with the content: '> Not sure which version -- using whatever is deployed on staging.' The analysis notes it 'contains only vague text with no extractable version identifier.'

assertion_results.text: Version resolution determines that no version identifier can be extracted from the vague description (Step 4.5.2)
assertion_results.evidence: In version-resolution.md lines 9-24, Step 4.5.2 scans the section content against four version identifier patterns (explicit version number, product-prefixed version, version keyword + number, numeric X.Y.Z), finds none, and concludes: 'The section contains only vague, non-specific text ("Not sure which version", "whatever is deployed on staging"). No version pattern could be extracted.'

assertion_results.text: Version resolution outputs the gap comment: 'Affects Version could not be determined from the bug description — please set manually.' (Step 4.5.6)
assertion_results.evidence: In version-resolution.md line 40, under Step 4.5.6, the gap comment is output as: '> Affects Version could not be determined from the bug description -- please set manually.' The wording matches the assertion (with '--' as the ASCII representation of the em dash).

assertion_results.text: The gap comment includes the Comment Footnote (Step 4.5.6)
assertion_results.evidence: In version-resolution.md line 42, the output states 'Comment would include the standard Comment Footnote per skill specification' but the actual Comment Footnote text is never shown or included in the gap comment. The output only declares intent to include the footnote without demonstrating it. The gap comment on line 40 contains no footnote.
